capabilities: Plot 2D curves and 3D surfaces from equations, including implicit and piecewise surfaces
Visualize 2D and 3D vector fields with adjustable sampling density
Group equations into systems and show intersections and numerical solution markers
Add points, vectors, and adjustable variables to graphs
Edit graphs through visual controls or directly in the JSON code block
disambiguation: Not related to Obsidian's Graph view of note links; it plots mathematical equations.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installation is manual from release files placed in the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plot mathematical equations or vector fields as interactive graphs within notes.
summary: Interactive 2D/3D math plotter that renders equations, vector fields, and systems as graphs inside notes via math-plot code blocks or a modal UI.
